Name: Shorts for Ladies
Author: Meevers
Description:
Hi there!
I made this mod as just a personal thing. So I could switch between [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/skirt-dress-for-male-or-female-farmer-round-face-for-males.109734/]Alex_01's skirts[/url] and my shorts whenever I felt like it. Therefore, I don't really see myself doing a male version of this mod, unfortunately. [i]If you personally would like to edit this mod to fit the male farmer base, then you have my permission to do so, just make sure to credit me.[/i]

[b]The base body I used is by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/216/?]RuneNL[/url] so credit goes to them for that.[/b] I have edited it to fit my personal tastes, therefore I have removed the breasts and the extended shoulders and fixed/changed a couple animations that I personally wasn't a fan of. I also added the vanilla sleeves and bikini back in, minus the sandals. The shorts are fully done and matched to animations by me.

[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]UPDATE 30/03/16: [/b][/size]
I edited the crotch area, made the shorts more compatible with light and bright colours, edited shading slightly, fixed a stray pixel and updated all pictures.

[u][b][size=4]Installation:[/size]

[/b][/u]First choose your preferred version - rounded face or vanilla face:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7lz5vmq.jpg[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/zu6mZLY.jpg[/img]

Navigate to your Stardew Valley installation folder and place the file into Content/Characters/Farmer -[b][size=3] make sure to make a backup of your original farmer_girl_base.xnb before replacing the file.[/size][/b]


[u][b]Currently working on:[/b][/u]

[s]-Editing the colours slightly so the shorts support light colours a little better without a harsh outline. [/s] - complete
-Perhaps making a shorter version, around 1 pixel shorter.

[u][b]Extra notes/credits:[/b][/u]

The hairstyles pictured are my personal edits of others mods: The first two are edits of the 2nd and 9th hairstyle seen on the [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/more-hair-updated-3-25.110265/page-6#post-2847281]More Hair mod by Pencilstab[/url] and the third is a personal edit of Leah's hairstyle. The last is a slight edit of the  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/163/?]Dangan Ronpa female hairs by ZeiaZeh[/url]. I will likely not release these, seen as they are simply personal edits of hairstyles that are [i]not[/i] fully made by me. Shirt on animations picture by [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/216/?]RuneNL[/url][/b], slightly edited by me.

Enjoy~
